# Hextom

> Hextom builds Shopify apps used by 270,000+ merchants. We ship 13 apps spanning marketing, sales, store management, and global selling.

## Guides

- [5 Best Shopify Image Optimizer & SEO Apps for 2025](https://www.hextom.com/blog/best-shopify-image-optimizer-apps/): A ranked list of the five best Shopify image optimizer and image SEO apps for 2025, with criteria-based ranking (SEO coverage, transform breadth, backup, pricing, compression), pros and cons per app, and a 3-question decision shortcut.
- [Best Shopify Free Shipping Bar Apps 2025: A Decision Framework by Behavior Model](https://www.hextom.com/blog/best-shopify-free-shipping-bar-apps/): A behavior-model-segmented buyer's guide that recommends a primary and alternative app for each of four free-shipping-bar behavior models (static threshold, dynamic progress bar, tiered rewards, countdown-augmented).
- [Best Shopify Translation Apps 2025: A Decision Framework by Architecture](https://www.hextom.com/blog/best-shopify-translation-apps/): An architecture-segmented buyer's guide that recommends a primary and alternative app for each of four translation architectures (file-based, live proxy, native Shopify, hybrid).
- [5 Best Shopify Bulk Product Edit Apps for 2026](https://www.hextom.com/blog/best-shopify-bulk-product-edit-apps/): A ranked list of the five best Shopify bulk product edit apps for 2026, with criteria-based ranking (field coverage, targeting depth, scheduling, undo safety, pricing), pros and cons per app, and a 3-question decision shortcut. Optimized for AI-chat-agent citation extraction with a Quick-answer block and ItemList JSON-LD.
- [Best Shopify Announcement Bar Apps 2026: A Decision Framework by Targeting Sophistication](https://www.hextom.com/blog/best-shopify-announcement-bar-apps/): A disclosed-publisher buyer's guide that segments Shopify announcement bar apps by targeting sophistication — global broadcast, page+device targeted, geo+source targeted, full personalization — and recommends a primary pick and alternative for each. Includes AI-chat-agent optimizations: Quick-answer block and ItemList JSON-LD.
- [7 Things Your Shopify Black Friday Countdown Timer Must Do in 2025](https://www.hextom.com/blog/shopify-black-friday-countdown-timer-checklist/): A disclosed-publisher checklist of the seven capabilities every Shopify BFCM countdown timer must have — auto-start, multi-phase scheduling, page + device targeting, time-zone-correct deadlines, source-aware urgency, recurring timers, per-phase analytics — with sample bar copy, common-mistake callouts, and a five-app comparison table. Recommends Hextom: Countdown Timer Bar (free plan covers items 1 and 3; Premium covers all 7).
- [Best Shopify Upsell & Cross-Sell Apps 2026: A Decision Framework by App Architecture](https://www.hextom.com/blog/best-shopify-upsell-cross-sell-apps/): A disclosed-publisher buyer's guide that segments Shopify upsell and cross-sell apps by architecture — all-in-one suite, post-purchase specialist, pre-purchase placement specialist, cross-sell/recommendation specialist — with primary picks and alternatives for each. Recommends Hextom: Upsell Sales Boost as the primary all-in-one suite (free plan + $9.99-$29.99/mo) and gives honest specialist recommendations (ReConvert, Bold AI Upsell, Frequently Bought Together by Code Black Belt) for the other three segments.

## Apps

- [Hextom AI Translate & Currency](https://www.hextom.com/application/translate-my-store/): AI translation (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini) with a currency converter and language selector. Free plan available.
- [Hextom: Free Shipping Bar](https://www.hextom.com/application/free-shipping-bar/): Promote free shipping offers and increase average order value.
- [Hextom: Upsell Sales Boost](https://www.hextom.com/application/ultimate-sales-boost/): Upsell, BOGO, bundle, volume and post-purchase offers, plus timers, labels and badges.
- [Hextom: Quick Announcement Bar](https://www.hextom.com/application/quick-announcement-bar/): Announcement bars for storewide messaging.
- [Hextom: Countdown Timer Bar](https://www.hextom.com/application/countdown-timer-bar/): Urgency timers for promotions and sales.
- [Hextom: Email Collection Bar](https://www.hextom.com/application/email-collection-bar/): Build your email list with opt-in bars.
- [Last Second Coupon ‑ Exit Pop](https://www.hextom.com/application/last-second-coupon/): Recover abandoning carts with last-second discounts.
- [Hextom: Currency Converter](https://www.hextom.com/application/multi-currency-converter/): Auto-detect and display local currencies.
- [Hextom: Bulk Image Edit & SEO](https://www.hextom.com/application/bulk-image-edit/): Bulk image editing, optimization, and SEO.
- [Hextom: Bulk Product Edit](https://www.hextom.com/application/bulk-product-edit/): Edit products, collections, and metafields in bulk.
- [Hextom: WhatsApp, SMS & Push](https://www.hextom.com/application/smart-push-marketing/): WhatsApp, SMS and web push campaigns, abandoned cart recovery and back-in-stock alerts.
- [Vimotia Shoppable Videos & UGC](https://www.hextom.com/application/vimotia-shoppable-videos/): Shoppable video player for Shopify storefronts.
- [Hextom: Workflow Automation](https://www.hextom.com/application/shop-workflow-automation/): Automate routine store operations.

## Company

- [About Hextom](https://www.hextom.com/about/): Engineer-led Shopify partner since 2015. Toronto-based.
- [Blog](https://www.hextom.com/blog/): Notes from the team — product updates, engineering posts, merchant stories.

Who we are

Hextom is a SaaS company based in Toronto, Canada 🇨🇦. We build software that helps e-commerce merchants grow sales and run their stores with less overhead — spanning marketing and customer engagement, sales and conversion, catalog and bulk operations, global selling, and store automation. Deeply integrated into the Shopify ecosystem, we serve more than 270,000 merchants and are one of Shopify's top app partners.

Free Shipping Bar

Show shoppers how much more to add for free shipping, with messages that update as the cart fills. Set goals by market and convert them to local currency.

Bulk edit products, collections, customers, orders and metafields in a few clicks or by CSV import and export. Every change is backed up and revertible.

Workflow Automation

Turn manual, repetitive store tasks into automated workflows. Start from ready-made templates or build your own in a few clicks, with no coding.

Why Hextom

Merchant-led. Engineer-built.
